purpose: Formally close the current autonomous scientific-recovery stage once all currently admissible accounting, reference-mode, source-discovery and behavioural-mechanism tasks have either completed their frozen gates or reached explicit evidence-triggered boundaries. Stage completion means no legitimate task remains executable from the current evidence set without violating preregistration, provenance, accounting or no-post-outcome-respecification rules. It does not mean that RMD is complete, calibrated, causally identified, behaviourally closed or release-ready.

accounting.completion_interpretation: Accounting recovery has reached explicit public-data/identification boundaries; incomplete instruments remain incomplete and may reopen only on their declared evidence triggers.

reference_modes.completion_interpretation: The sole blocker has exhausted admissible current public source paths without a boundary-valid quarterly non-consolidated sector-by-counterpart stock+transaction source. BNR annual CNF gives exact 2024 counterpart-stock semantics; BNR quarterly S13 gives a long stock/transaction sequence but only for consolidated general government; neither can be promoted to the full RMD boundary.

behavioural_mechanisms.completion_interpretation: Every non-rejected mechanism is frozen, waiting for an external event, or blocked by a declared source/measurement/identification trigger.

prospective_monetary_confirmation.interpretation: Future external events may reopen a prospective confirmation gate; elapsed time and unchanged-rate meetings are not scientific progress.

stage_completion_rule.rationale: A scientifically disciplined recovery stage can terminate with unresolved model components when the remaining uncertainty is structural/source-limited and every reopen condition is explicit. Continuing to search or refit without a new trigger would reduce scientific integrity rather than increase it.

reopen_classes.rule: A declared instrument-specific source/constraint in the accounting reopen registry becomes available.
A new or changed official dataset satisfies the sectoral-financial-position quarterly S121 + F2-F8 stock/transaction boundary.
A mechanism-specific trigger in the behavioural reopen registry is satisfied.
A future non-zero BNR policy-rate event and subsequent official MIR release satisfy the frozen prospective-confirmation contract.

non_reopen_conditions: Repeating unchanged source searches or API probes.
Post-outcome lag, predictor, sign, regime or target changes on a failed evidence cycle.
Relaxing source frequency, sector, instrument, population or precision boundaries after observing availability.
Using rounded, interpolated, synthetic or residual-balanced values where exact evidence is required.
Opening reserved holdouts or prospective response values outside their frozen gates.

permitted_actions_without_reopen_trigger: monitoring only the explicitly declared external/event triggers
prohibited_actions_without_reopen_trigge: canonical accounting completion by synthetic allocation
